entradas.text: "So... let's just move on to our plan with Isabel."
entradas.menu: "So... let's just move on to our plan with Isabel."

entradas.text: "Thank you. That means a lot."
"But seriously, I want to know more about you."
entradas.menu: "But seriously, I want to know more about you."

entradas.text: She looked at me with surprise.
"Let's talk about you a little."
entradas.menu: "Let's talk about you a little."

entradas.text: Nia took a sip from her glass of water and looked at me.
"Do you think we'll succeed?"
entradas.menu: "Do you think we'll succeed?"

entradas.text: I stayed silent.
entradas.menu: Stay silent.

entradas.text: "Do you really think we're a strong team though?"
"Yes. I believe we are in a good position now. The anti-corruption force helped a lot."
"I'd like to hope so, yes."
"Do you really think so?"
"We only need either Isabel's or Heron's vote."
"Where is Isabel? I don't like waiting."
entradas.menu: "Where is Isabel? I don't like waiting."

entradas.text: "Come on, Mr. President. Don't overthink this. We just need to focus on Isabel."
She smiled.
"We might need to get both Isabel and Heron to work with us. I don't want to rely on Isabel to bring exactly three votes. It's risky."
"Anyway... I think Isabel is going to be here very soon. Maybe we should return back to the topic."
"Anyway, let's talk about what we'll do with Isabel."
entradas.menu: "Anyway, let's talk about what we'll do with Isabel."

entradas.text: "But anyway..."
"I don't think they are what they used to be. It changed a lot."
entradas.menu: "I don't think they are what they used to be. It changed a lot."

entradas.text: "Let's not overthink this though, Mr. President. We have to focus on the meeting with Isabel now."
"Very funny, Mr. President."
"Hmm. I used to be part of the Red Youth during my university years."
entradas.menu: "Hmm. I used to be part of the Red Youth during my university years."

entradas.text: She took another sip from her glass.
"Well..."
She didn't say anything and leaned over to look out the window.
"Hmm. I used to be part of the Young Sords during my university years."
entradas.menu: "Hmm. I used to be part of the Young Sords during my university years."

entradas.text: I kept silent.
entradas.menu: Keep staying silent.

entradas.text: "You and I. We are a strong team Nia. We will succeed."
entradas.menu: "You and I. We are a strong team Nia. We will succeed."

entradas.text: She watched the beautiful sunset from the window. Then she brought her eyes back to me.
"I'm sure she'll be here shortly."
"Alphonso was just a rich businessman. I couldn't trust him."
entradas.menu: "Alphonso was just a rich businessman. I couldn't trust him."

entradas.text: I looked back at her.
entradas.menu: Look at her.

entradas.text: "I didn't support Alphonso's free market policies."
entradas.menu: "I didn't support Alphonso's free market policies."

entradas.text: I looked out the window and saw the crimson sky with almost maroon-colored clouds over the horizon.
entradas.menu: Watch the sunset.

entradas.text: "Soll wasn't that bad."
entradas.menu: "Soll wasn't that bad."

entradas.text: She smiled at me, then averted her gaze.
"This was always what I've worked towards. Nothing has changed one bit."
"They became a militant extremist group that threatens Sordland."
entradas.menu: "They became a militant extremist group that threatens Sordland."

entradas.text: "You and I. We are a strong team Nia."
entradas.menu: "You and I. We are a strong team Nia."

entradas.text: "Me?"
"Well yes, that's the same for me too."
"Yes. How have you been holding up these rough days?"
entradas.menu: "Yes. How have you been holding up these rough days?"

entradas.text: "So... How about you? How have you been holding up?"
entradas.menu: "So... How about you? How have you been holding up?"

entradas.text: "Is everything fine with you?"
entradas.menu: "Is everything fine with you?"

entradas.text: "How about you tell me something first?"
"I'm disappointed that you couldn't get the Court for me."
entradas.menu: "I'm disappointed that you couldn't get the Court for me."

entradas.text: "Honestly, I still support their cause."
entradas.menu: "Honestly, I still support their cause."

entradas.text: "Yes. I want to know more about you."
entradas.menu: "Yes. I want to know more about you."

entradas.text: "I thought you were aware about the situation in the Court."
"It's fine, Mr. President."
"I already have two Justices working with me. The court is dominated by Orso's crew so there's not much room to work with."
She frowned at me first and then smiled.
"Also, let's not forget that I persuaded Isabel into meeting with you, Mr. President."
"But anyway, she'll be here soon."
"So you really did support Tarquin Soll..."
"I'm fine, Mr. President. Thanks for asking."
"So you really did support Tarquin Soll..."
"What do you want to know?"
She was not at all impressed with my reply.
"I'm just focused on our proposal. If it passes the Supreme Court, this will be a historical moment for Sordland."
"I see..."
"I just... don't want to see another failure trying to change this Constitution anymore."
"I had the exact same belief. He proved us wrong very quickly though."
"It's not the end of the world if it doesn't go through."
entradas.menu: "It's not the end of the world if it doesn't go through."

entradas.text: "That's true. He was the only option for sure."
"That's why we can't become another Alphonso administration."
entradas.menu: "That's why we can't become another Alphonso administration."

entradas.text: "Me neither, Mrs. Morgna. We have to make sure we succeed."
entradas.menu: "Me neither, Mrs. Morgna. We have to make sure we succeed."

entradas.text: She was not at all impressed with my reply.
"Don't let your emotions get in the way."
entradas.menu: "Don't let your emotions get in the way."

entradas.text: "I see..."
"Great motivational speech, Mr. President."
"Thank you, Mr. President. I respect your ideals too."
She let out a short laugh followed by a sigh.
"Of course, Mr. President."
"I've done my best so far, Mr. President. It's up to you now to persuade Isabel."
"There is not much to tell. I am a pretty regular man outside politics."
entradas.menu: "There is not much to tell. I am a pretty regular man outside politics."

entradas.text: "She's the last remaining piece of the puzzle. We are close to finalizing it but that idea alone is enough to make me a little stressed."
"What do you want to know?"
entradas.menu: "What do you want to know?"

entradas.text: "I'm slightly scared that Isabel's help might not be enough. That we might need Heron's help one way or another..."
"What do you think about them now?"
"You're exactly right. I've had my experience with his administration when I worked as a vice minister."
"Did you know that I am one of the top four best presidents of Sordland?"
entradas.menu: "Did you know that I am one of the top four best presidents of Sordland?"

entradas.text: "But it was not Alphonso who was to blame. The Old Guard put enormous pressure on him and the Justice Ministry back then."
"Oh really?"
"I guess it's not so different today."
"Are you kidding me?"
"I hope we succeed."
"I don't really know what to say. You already know about my background experience."
"It was obvious that he would win. I saw that as an investment."
entradas.menu: "It was obvious that he would win. I saw that as an investment."

entradas.text: "Tell me about your past."
entradas.menu: "Tell me about your past."

entradas.text: "It was time for Soll to leave. He was the only alternative."
entradas.menu: "It was time for Soll to leave. He was the only alternative."

entradas.text: "We usually don't have time to talk alone. I was just interested to know more about you."
entradas.menu: "We usually don't have time to talk alone. I was just interested to know more about you."

entradas.text: "At the time, I really believed that Alphonso would do great things."
entradas.menu: "At the time, I really believed that Alphonso would do great things."

entradas.text: "What do you aim to achieve?"
entradas.menu: "What do you aim to achieve?"

entradas.text: "I agree."
"A fair and transparent justice system for Sordland."
She took another sip from her water.
"We'll do it together."
entradas.menu: "We'll do it together."

entradas.text: "I respect that."
entradas.menu: "I respect that."

entradas.text: "At the time, I really wanted him to continue leading the party."
entradas.menu: "At the time, I really wanted him to continue leading the party."

entradas.text: "I meant other than that."
entradas.menu: "I meant other than that."

entradas.text: "He promised me a seat in his cabinet. I couldn't say no."
entradas.menu: "He promised me a seat in his cabinet. I couldn't say no."

entradas.text: "For some reason I'm sceptical about that."
entradas.menu: "For some reason I'm sceptical about that."

entradas.text: "I didn't want Alphonso's leadership."
entradas.menu: "I didn't want Alphonso's leadership."

entradas.text: "What do you mean? Have you seen any hypocrisy from me? I doubt that."
"Tell me, Mr. President... Why did you vote for Alphonso in the '46 Congress?"
"Thank you, Mr. President. I respect your ideals too."
"Tell me, Mr. President... Why did you vote for Soll in the '46 Congress?"
"Hmm. You mean more personal aims? I might want to settle down at some point in a coastal town like Lachaven. I'd like that."
"Toppling Soll's Constitution would be the grandest thing that I can achieve. Other dreams will come later."
"But I really can't think of anything personal these days. My dream is to see real democracy in Sordland. The republic's history has been pitch black."
"I can achieve anything with a woman like you by my side."
entradas.menu: "I can achieve anything with a woman like you by my side."

entradas.text: "Oh, you're being too nice, Mr. President."
"My past? I thought you've read my biography before you chose me for the cabinet, Mr. President."
She let out a short laughter.
She took a while to respond.
"It is true that they have a militant wing but I wouldn't call them a real threat."
"If you don't want to share, it's okay."
entradas.menu: "If you don't want to share, it's okay."

entradas.text: "You are a strong woman, Nia."
entradas.menu: "You are a strong woman, Nia."

entradas.text: "I guess that's correct."
entradas.menu: "I guess that's correct."

entradas.text: "Of course. We have done a great deal so far."
entradas.menu: "Of course. We have done a great deal so far."

entradas.text: "Oh, okay."
"I couldn't do any of this without you."
entradas.menu: "I couldn't do any of this without you."

entradas.text: She frowned.
She gave me an inscrutable look.
"They became a militant extremist group that threatens Sordland."
entradas.menu: "They became a militant extremist group that threatens Sordland."

entradas.text: "Time will tell."
entradas.menu: "Time will tell."

entradas.text: "I mean... I don't really know what to say. You already know about my background experience."
"Anyway... Isabel's going to be here any minute."
"I guess so."
"I'm sure she'll be here shortly."
"That's not what I meant."
entradas.menu: "That's not what I meant."

entradas.text: "But I think it was always a ultranationalist group, Mr. President."
"Anyway, let's talk about what we'll do with Isabel."
entradas.menu: "Anyway, let's talk about what we'll do with Isabel."

entradas.text: "I think it was always just *that*, Mr. President."
"It's okay, I didn't want to put you on the spot."
entradas.menu: "It's okay, I didn't want to put you on the spot."

entradas.text: "Anyway, let's talk about what we'll do with Isabel."
entradas.menu: "Anyway, let's talk about what we'll do with Isabel."

entradas.text: "Well, I guess that's true."
"Where is Isabel? I don't like waiting."
entradas.menu: "Where is Isabel? I don't like waiting."

entradas.text: She smiled.
"Thank you. It really means a lot."
"I respect that a lot."
entradas.menu: "I respect that a lot."

entradas.text: "You do?"
"I'm sorry, you've got me wrong."
entradas.menu: "I'm sorry, you've got me wrong."

entradas.text: Nia took another sip from her glass of water and looked at me.
"Come on, Nia. I'm just trying to have a conversation."
entradas.menu: "Come on, Nia. I'm just trying to have a conversation."

entradas.text: "The way you said it felt like it was a rehearsed statement."
entradas.menu: "The way you said it felt like it was a rehearsed statement."

entradas.text: "Yes. We will, Mr. President!"
"Really?"
She took another sip from her glass.
She was visibly annoyed.
"What do you think about them now?"
"But anyway, Isabel will be here soon."
"I didn't know that."
"Don't worry, we've got this."
entradas.menu: "Don't worry, we've got this."

entradas.text: She took another sip from her glass.
"Interesting..."
"Honestly, I still support their cause."
entradas.menu: "Honestly, I still support their cause."

entradas.text: "Not really."
entradas.menu: "Not really."

entradas.text: "I don't think they are what they used to be. It changed a lot."
entradas.menu: "I don't think they are what they used to be. It changed a lot."
